subject: general
question: In October 2022, according to UN Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI), which country has the largest number of poor people worldwide?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) of 2022 was released by United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI).
 
• It was first launched in 2010.
 
• India has the largest number of poor people followed by Nigeria.
 
• Bihar is the poorest state in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The MPI monitors 10 major indicators of deprivations.
 
• These are:

 
 

 Dimensions
 Indicators
 Poverty Measures
 
 

 1. Health
 
 
 
• Nutrition
 
• Child mortality
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
2. Education

 
 
 
 
• Years in schooling
 
• School attendance
 
 
 
 
 
• Intensity of poverty
 
• Headcount ratio
 
 
 
 

 3. Standard of Living
 
 
 
• Cooking fuel
 
• Sanitation
 
• Drinking water
 
• Electricity
 
• Housing
